independentScientificDecisions.reason: Both full application materials explicitly provide change→gene product→property/use and exposure/evidence models. The learner must actually understand these and argue from them. Autonomously explaining plasmids, cloning strategies and expression systems is not a universal prior requirement of this discussion competence. Removing only the vector mastery barrier is didactically coherent; it does not award vector mastery or remove the distinct HE LK method duty.

The full edited-cell and edited-crop cases provide intended edit, functional evidence, targeting/detection limits and inheritance/environmental conditions. The application discussion supplies prior weighing. Independent technical CRISPR explanation remains a separate valid goal; its mastery is not a necessary universal barrier to these material-supported arguments.

The standalone vector/cloning/expression description is scientifically sound and retains its method prerequisites. HE39 places the relevant vector/cloning duty at LK; removing RP003 contribution is separate from deleting this goal.

The standalone method description is scientifically sound and retains application discussion as prerequisite. HE39 CRISPR method and risks/chances are distinct LK items; discussion must not award method mastery.

Actual RP printed44 requests argumentation and basic overview, selecting relevant applications and excluding molecular detail depth. Only this argumentation line fails to justify mandatory autonomous PCR/gel, vector/cloning or CRISPR method mastery. Keeping three material-supported argumentation/evaluation contributions as partial is coherent. Other source rows, selection of applications, audience presentation/research and full operator coverage remain separate.

Why Biology fixes the subject-name translation. The proposed full EN description agrees with DE and the orientation contract: concrete possibilities and positive perspectives, curiosity/continuation choice, no assumed or assessed scientific detail. It removes the prior required relevance explanation and durable-competence assertion without adding assessment.

normalProjectionImpact: Only RP SekI targets for the three method goals disappear. The three argumentation targets remain; 395 source-union atoms/24 views remain technically unchanged. These are routing counts, not source completion.

orientationFields.before: Big-picture entry: The learner can explain why Biologie matters for everyday life, social participation, studies, and career, and how working through this curriculum systematically leads to durable competence growth.
orientationFields.after: The big-picture introduction shows the possibilities biology opens up in everyday life, social participation, studies and careers, and the positive perspectives offered by the following material. The learner only chooses what sparks their curiosity or whether they would like to continue learning; subject-specific detail is neither required nor assessed here.
